# Screens — F001_Auth

## Screen List

| Screen Name | SCR### | What User Sees | What User Can Do |
|-------------|--------|----------------|------------------|
| Login | SCR001_Login | An email and password form | Submit credentials to sign in |

## User Journey

1. User arrives at Login and sees an email and password form.
2. User submits the form — the system verifies credentials.
3. User is taken to Dashboard where their saved orders appear.
